action.expr: (()=>{const ds=document.querySelectorAll('#cotizar input[type=date]');const r=ds[ds.length-1];const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(r,r.min||ds[0].value);r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const d=ds[0];const t=new Date(Date.now()+5*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10);set.call(d,t);d.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));d.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return [d.value,r.value]})()
